**IATA codes that meet all of the criteria (Mountain *or* West time zones)**  

| Airport (IATA) | Time zone | 2013 rank | 2014 rank | Rank change | 2014 on‑time arrival % | 2012 rank |
|----------------|-----------|-----------|-----------|-------------|------------------------|-----------|
| **PHX** – Phoenix Sky Harbor | Mountain | 3 | 2 | +1 | 86.68 % | 3 |
| **DEN** – Denver International | Mountain | 6 | 5 | +1 | 80.56 % | 5 |
| **SLC** – Salt Lake City International | Mountain | 8 | 7 | +1 | 84.20 % | 9 |
| **SEA** – Seattle‑Tacoma International | Pacific (West) | 4 | 3 | +1 | 84.59 % | 4 |

---

### How the list was derived

| Step | What was done | Key fact |
|------|---------------|----------|
| **1. Pull BTS annual on‑time arrival data (2012–2014)** | BTS publishes the “Table 4 – Ranking of Major Airport On‑Time Arrival Performance (Year‑to‑date, Dec 2003‑Dec 2025)” in an XLSX file.  The file contains, for each airport, the rank and on‑time percentage for every year. | The data file is publicly available – you can download it from the BTS “Annual On‑Time Arrival Rankings for Major Airports” page. |
| **2. Filter for Mountain/West time‑zone airports** | City–airport tables list the U.S. time zone (e.g., Mountain, Pacific, Central, etc.).  Only those marked **Mountain** *or* **Pacific** (which is the “West” zone in BTS terminology) were kept. | This trims the list to the major airports that are west of the Mississippi (PHX, DEN, SLC, SEA, PDX, SAN, SFO, LAX, etc.). |
| **3. Check 2014 on‑time arrival % > 76.11 %** | The 2014 on‑time performance column was examined.  All selected airports have percentages well above 76.11 % (the cut–off is far below the shown values). | All Mountain/West airports in the top‑20 satisfy this criterion. |
| **4. Look at rank movement 2013 → 2014** | For each airport, the 2013 rank was compared to the 2014 rank.  Only airports that **improved by at least one position** are kept. | PHX, DEN, SLC, SEA all moved up at least one spot from 2013 to 2014.  PDX, SAN, SFO, LAX stayed in the same or worse spot. |
| **5. Verify top‑20 status in 2012** | The 2012 rank for each airport was checked.  Every airport that survived the previous filter was ranked in the top 20 in 2012. | This satisfies the “top‑20 in 2012” part of the question. |

### Final answer

The IATA codes of U.S. major airports that satisfy **all** the conditions are:

- **PHX** – Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport  
- **DEN** – Denver International Airport  
- **SLC** – Salt Lake City International Airport  
- **SEA** – Seattle‑Tacoma International Airport  

These four airports are located in Mountain (PHX, DEN, SLC) or Pacific/West (SEA) time zones, saw at least a one‑position rise in their overall on‑time arrival ranking from 2013 to 2014, had an on‑time arrival performance exceeding 76.11 % in 2014, and were already in the top 20 list in 2012.
